mechanics.claim: Gnar is locked out of moving and casting movement abilities for 0.175 seconds after the cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''Gnar''' is locked out of moving and casting movement abilities for {{tt|{{fd|0.175}} seconds|Estimated}} after the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Enemies that collide with terrain take 50% increased damage immediately instead of the delayed base damage, and are stunned instead of slowed.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that collide with terrain take {{ccs|50% increased damage|physical}} immediately and are {{tip|stun|stunned}} instantly instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}} after a delay.

mechanics.claim: The base knockback damage applies after a 0.4-second delay following the knockback, while the terrain-collision damage applies immediately.
mechanics.quote: afterwards dealing them {{as|physical damage}}, as well as {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay for a duration
